survey: NFPS 2009-2015 household/member, original questionnaires and dictionaries; baseline 2010
linkage: uniquely matched hhid in 2010 and target wave, original id also agrees; exact frozen V3 cohort and two confirmed area-field corrections
weights: unweighted matched sample, V3 initialization draw is not a validation survey weight

definitions.sown_denominator: all linked households with both nonnegative observed food and cash crop area; grain-food combination excludes other crop, keep its observed class
definitions.grain_shares: P25/P50/P75, linear percentiles on strictly positive grain+cash sowing within the comparable household set
definitions.stock_denominator: linked households with nonnegative opening and strictly positive closing observed physical operating stock, regardless of sowing
definitions.invalid: no negative, unknown or inconsistent stock imputed or assimilated to zero; where a metric denominator is missing/zero, cannot decide
definitions.coverage_rationale: 300 is half the fixed initialization roster and avoids a small selected subset passing a whole-cohort group; initial area, retained coverage and lack of population inference still reported. Subgroups below 30 are not rated.

independent_gate.rule: verify provenance before inspecting outcomes; selection unit distinct from development, adequate compatible paired observations, includes observed initialization and subsequent years; all 20 seeds for every predeclared external group-year must pass all applicable gates and integrity
independent_gate.missing_evidence: cannot decide; route C after completing historical replay
independent_gate.government: no formal training, policy rankings or reward selection without genuine independent recursive coverage

candidate_selection: carry over F1 behavioral rules unless a source-grounded change explains the linked evidence without contaminating the holdout; evaluate the stock ledger even if leave behavioral rules unchanged
additional_flow_gate: not set: sparse dual reporter overlap and incomplete stock-flow accounting prevent using reported flows as a blanket acceptance gate
